title: Investigating Middle School Students’ Question-Asking and Answer-Evaluation Skills When Using ChatGPT for Science Investigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on students' cognitive skills such as question formulation and answer evaluation when interacting with ChatGPT for science learning. While it includes a questionnaire sub-scale on students' perceptions of AI fairness and ethics and contains a standard section on procedural ethics for the study, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary research component.
